description: This file defines the SaveHolidayController class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. The controller manages the pre-render setup for holiday-related views, including configuring components and properties based on request data. It also contains a constant list of holiday length options.

classes.name: SaveHolidayController
classes.description: A controller that manages the pre-render process for holiday management views, setting up components and properties depending on whether a holiday ID is present in the request.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by setting up a 'holiday-edit' or 'holiday-save' component based on request attributes and attaches relevant properties.
